_docs.purpose: Canonical shape for privacy-minimised commercial measurement events. This is a contract for the tracker/backend; it does not itself collect data.
_docs.privacy: No email address, name, precise GPS coordinate, fingerprint, free-form user agent, or cross-site identifier belongs in this event.

retention.raw_event_guidance: Keep raw measurement only as long as operationally necessary; prefer aggregated reporting for long-term analysis.
